description: Tenant-aware caching for Tenantry: tenant.IsolateCaches() keys HybridCache entries by the current tenant, so one tenant's cached data is never served to another, with SharedHybridCache for entries every tenant shares and ITenantDistributedCache for IDistributedCache; invalidating a tenant removes i…

HTTP and gRPC integration for Tenantry: UseTenantry() on an HttpClient or gRPC client sends the current tenant to the service it calls, in the tenantry-tenant-id header, which Tenantry.AspNetCore's ResolveFromPropagationHeader reads from callers it trusts.

Per-tenant options for Tenantry: tenant.ConfigurePerTenant(...) makes IOptionsSnapshot and IOptionsMonitor return the current tenant's values, built from your configuration plus the tenant, cached per tenant, and cleared when the tenant is invalidated.
